:::{#rem-cosine-restarts}
#### Restarting the cosine schedule

Restarting the schedule periodically is a common variant of [cosine decay](#def-cosine-decay) [@loshchilov2017sgdr]:
jump the [step length](#def-gradient-descent) back to $\iterpoint{\steplen}{0}$ and decay again.
The reason for it is that the jump can move the [iterates](#def-iterate) out of one [basin of attraction](#def-basin-of-attraction) and into a better one.

:::
